glossary.definition: (B) As used in this section, "body armor" means any vest, helmet, shield, or similar item that is designed or specifically carried to diminish the impact of a bullet or projectile upon the offender's body.
glossary.source_title: Section 2941.1411 - Offender wore or carried body armor specification.
